scope: Exact-gap underwriting on active T0 backlog under backpressure; cumulative evidence reused and no ordinary fresh names opened.
summary: TER's legacy convertible/warrant complex is no longer a current debt gate: notes matured in 2023 and warrants completed expiry in 2024. Current TER gate is narrowed to 2026 governance/SBC plus current debt/capital-allocation normalization. SERV Q2 2026 SEC filing supplies a current $79.112M cash anchor but runway, ATM/warrant/SBC capacity and concentration still require exact note extraction before reproducible treatment.

claims: The historical 1.25% convertible senior notes matured December 15, 2023; they should not be modeled as current debt.
Associated warrants finished expiring by July 10, 2024; historical issuances belong in prior dilution history rather than current potential-share capacity.

A later SEC filing showed 160.420M common shares outstanding as of April 28, 2025 and 161.996M diluted weighted-average shares for Q1 2025, demonstrating the lawful normalization pattern but not substituting for 2026 figures.
Teradyne disclosed intent to repurchase up to $1.0B of common stock during 2025-2026, making current capital-allocation normalization material.
risks: Using historical convertibles as current debt would overstate leverage/dilution risk; using 2025 share counts as current would understate possible 2026 SBC or repurchase effects.
contradictions: Queue's broad 'debt/convertible assembly' is partially stale: legacy convertibles/warrants are extinguished. The live gate is current debt plus 2026 SBC/governance/capital allocation.
unknowns: 2026 current basic/fully diluted share count, unvested equity awards, current debt balances and repurchase execution.
evidence.exactGate: Normalize current 2026 SBC/governance dilution, current debt and executed repurchases using the 2026 definitive proxy plus latest 2026 10-Q; do not carry the matured 2016 notes or expired warrants as current exposure.
evidence.nextLawfulSourcePath: Teradyne 2026 definitive proxy equity-compensation tables and latest 2026 Form 10-Q debt/equity/share-count notes.

claims: Serve reported $79.112M cash and cash equivalents at June 30, 2026 versus $106.239M at December 31, 2025 in its Q2 2026 Form 10-Q.
risks: Cash declined over the first half and must be paired with operating cash use and committed financing capacity before runway is judged.
Equity financing/warrant/SBC capacity may materially dilute holders.
Customer/partner concentration can make early revenue highly volatile.
unknowns: Exact H1 operating cash burn/runway normalization, unused ATM capacity, warrant/SBC overhang and current customer/partner concentration percentages.
evidence.exactGate: Extract from the Q2 2026 10-Q the H1 operating cash use, current ATM/equity issuance capacity, warrant/SBC overhang and customer/partner concentration so survival/dilution/concentration can be reproduced without narrative assumptions.
evidence.nextLawfulSourcePath: Serve Robotics Q2 2026 Form 10-Q cash-flow statement plus equity/warrant, revenue/customer concentration and commitments notes; use linked prospectus only for remaining ATM capacity if the 10-Q incorporates it by reference.

blockingIssues.nextLawfulSourcePath: Q2 2026 10-Q notes and incorporated ATM prospectus if required.
